resolutions: A VNC supplement remains a complete typed clause; an English participle, relative clause, or infinitive translation cannot reduce its grammatical status.
Shared subject, object, and possessor relations are licensed by referent identity between typed participants, not by nearby surface forms.
A VNC supplement does not require a separate construction switch; capturing the VNC Result makes its available roles part of the ordinary supplementation decision.
Optional in scopes over the complete adjoined clause and traditional fused spelling remains a non-authorizing written projection.
Recursive VNC supplementation preserves an acyclic typed graph and never infers a hierarchy from English word order.
Demonstrative plural existentials are derived from the typed defective i-a VNC plus the selected demonstrative NNC.
Interrogative existential person or number mismatch is a narrow typed exception and is not exposed as an agreement override.
Traditional solid existential spellings do not identify or authorize the underlying grammatical construction.
Included reference makes the complete adjoined clause a third-person singular referent rather than unifying a pronoun inside that clause with the principal head.
Shared and included analyses remain distinct and both are retained only where the typed structure and Andrews leave both readings open.
An included clause may fill a subject or possessor head while preserving any separate shared-reference relations inside the clause.
Typed ca and in retain their own clause scope through included-reference recursion and cannot be reconstructed from punctuation or display strings.
A captured utterance Result determines whether its internal sentence is a statement, question, command, or exclamation; the user does not classify it again.
Direct versus indirect reporting remains a real composition choice for typed speech predicates and cannot be inferred from quotation marks.
An indirect command must retain its licensed future indicative clause; an English infinitive translation cannot authorize another mood or tense.
The complete caused proposition fills the matrix object head while causer, causee, internal subject, and any silent object remain distinct typed participants.
The complete requested proposition fills the requesting predicate's object head without turning requester, addressee, and internal subject into manual exception controls.
Honorific, negative, impersonal, and causative shapes remain properties of their captured Results and are not rebuilt by supplementation.
A realizable wish is derived from its licensed future indicative or nonpast optative Result, so no separate realizability choice appears when only that reading fits.
A past optative wish without antecessive marking supports the impossible reading but not a past counterfactual reading.
Past counterfactual wish content requires the typed past optative and antecessive scope; neither an English gloss nor a display marker can supply it.
Negative scope remains attached to the typed wish or matrix Result and is not moved by the included-reference link.
Perception, cognition, and affect content roles are derived from the typed principal predicate rather than exposed as generic subject or object switches.
A perception complement normally requires the captured present-tense proposition; an English past translation cannot replace its typed tense.
Cognition, remembering, and forgetting preserve the complete proposition, its sentence type, participants, tense, and any nested supplementation.
An affect proposition is a supplementary subject, not an object chosen by proximity or English word order.
An infinitive-like English reading is licensed only when an eligible principal has a complete future VNC with the same typed subject referent.
The same-subject future remains a two-clause supplementation structure even when English translates its second clause as an infinitive.
The incorporated nequi alternative is a separate derivational route and cannot be manufactured by joining two composed clause surfaces.
Rumored report requires the fixed owner-issued third-person singular preterit quil frame and a complete captured report proposition.
Optional mach changes the report projection, while joined quilmach spelling is offered only after mach is present and never authorizes the grammar.
A quil report presents hearsay without making the reporter responsible for the truth of the included proposition.
Deleting a saying principal requires the full typed saying relation, its shared speaker and addressee, silent included-object head, and complete utterance.
The surviving speech action or adverb has no direct grammatical relation to the reported proposition; the deleted saying node remains recoverable.
Full versus licensed deleted composition and direct versus indirect reporting remain user choices only when both final structures are valid.
